🌪️ Meteorological Hazards: Global Tornado Distribution

Discipline: Environmental Geology & Natural Hazards Paper Code: GPGM - 5/20 Source: OPSC Mining Officer (Applied Geology) Exam
Official Examination Question
Tornadoes are common in which of the following countries ?
(A) India
(B) Bangladesh
(C) China
(D) U.S.A.
Part I

Applied Geology & Mining Engineering Foundations

1. Applied Geology & Mining Engineering Foundations

This problem evaluates Meteorological Hazards: Global Tornado Distribution within the framework of Environmental Geology & Natural Hazards.

In standard geological and mining operations, the definitive verified conclusion establishes that: U.S.A. (Tornado Alley in the central Great Plains experiences the world's highest frequency of intense supercell tornadoes).

Authoritative Reference Citation:

Edward A. Keller (Environmental Geology, 9th Ed., Ch. 8); K.M. Bangar (p. 25)

Part II

Forensic Option Dissection & Error Analysis

Option (A): India — INCORRECT

Does not satisfy the primary diagnostic criteria for this applied geology concept.

Option (B): Bangladesh — INCORRECT

Represents an alternative or non-applicable parameter.

Option (C): China — INCORRECT

Fails to meet the specific technical requirements of the problem statement.

Option (D): U.S.A. — CORRECT ANSWER

Accurately satisfies the foundational geological definition and official examination standard.
